name.en-US: An Essay in Aid of a Grammar of Assent
name.pt-BR: Ensaio em Auxílio de uma Gramática do Assentimento

description.en-US: Newman's philosophical work of 1870 on how the mind comes to believe. Part I distinguishes notional from real assent, and apprehension from inference. Part II studies assent and certitude, and in the Illative Sense gives the faculty by which we judge concrete matters; the last chapters apply it to the evidences of natural and revealed religion.
description.pt-BR: A obra filosófica de Newman (1870) sobre como a mente chega a crer. A primeira parte distingue o assentimento nocional do real e a apreensão da inferência. A segunda estuda o assentimento e a certeza e, no Sentido Ilativo, descreve a faculdade pela qual julgamos as questões concretas; os últimos capítulos a aplicam às provas da religião natural e da revelada.

en-US.editor: John Henry Newman (Longmans text; Newman Reader)

sources.edition: An Essay in Aid of a Grammar of Assent (London: Longmans, Green, 1870 and later impressions), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
sources.description: 11 chapters: Newman Reader page numbers, navigation and its editorial remarks are dropped; Newman's own notes are kept as footnotes. Chapters 4, 5, 6, 8 and 10 each join the Newman Reader's pages for their sections. The two Dublin Review notices of the book (by others) are left out. Raw page text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain: Newman died in 1890 and the text is of a Longmans impression (or earlier edition) before 1930. The Newman Reader page footers claim copyright in the site's transcription (c) 2007 NINS; a plain transcription of a public-domain text adds no authorship under US law.
